findings.reason: This label sits above the All/Work/Life view filter. Scope matches the Thai label and avoids confusion with the separate Life Area concept.

notes: Reviewed all 459 string leaves in each locale across the 23 requested namespaces. The locales have matching key sets and ICU placeholder parity; the targeted audit found zero placeholder mismatches.

Used GitNexus query/context for the shell, authentication, onboarding, settings, notifications, PWA and photo flows, then verified relevant source call sites. Combined with the parent’s production TSX literal scan, no clear uncataloged user-facing prose was found in the requested surfaces; decorative marks, technical identifiers and comments were excluded.

The legacy onboarding.firstGoal copy describes automatic weekly goal/task creation, but /onboarding/first-goal redirects through nextRouteFor and createFirstGoal returns the Starter route without persisting a generated cascade. It is not part of the current visible onboarding flow, so no wording proposal is made; consider a separate dead-key cleanup.
settings.empty and the older onboarding.persona/personas copy were not referenced by the current UI during source search; they were counted and reviewed but are not proposed for rewriting.
If the iPad install wording is adopted, extend the pwa.install.iosSteps Thai-token allowlist in catalogs.test.ts to include iPad.
